0022600006.text: The Cavaliers open their 2026-27 season on the road against the 76ers, who are 1-0, first in the Atlantic Division and third in the East, and riding a one-game winning streak. Cleveland won all four meetings in the 2025-26 season, 4-0, most recently a 115-101 win in Cleveland on March 9, 2026. Cleveland is missing Khalifa Diop (knee) and Nae'Qwan Tomlin (back) and has Jarrett Allen (knee) day-to-day as a game-time decision, while Philadelphia is without Ariel Hukporti (ruptured Achilles), Dominick Barlow (back) and Tacko Fall (quadriceps), with Dean Wade (ankle sprain) day-to-day as a game-time decision.
